'''Morro''' was an elder of [[Drop Canyon]] on the planet [[Ceriun]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].

==Biography==
Morro was one of several elders who met to decided what course of action to take about a [[Holocron/Legends|Holocron]] that was recovered from a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that had crashed near their village. The dying Jedi had bequeathed the elders with the artifact, which he requested that they keep safe until another Jedi appeared to claim it.

When the elders met to debate the matter of the holocron, [[Tenno]], a local youth, and his friends armed themselves and appeared at the meeting to seize the holocron for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]. A brawl broke out, during which several of the adults were killed. Morro himself was slain by his own son, [[Flass]], who killed his father with an [[Axe/Legends|axe]] blow to his face.
